# Sections of two syncs by OCaml Unison 2.54.0 (Homebrew, OCaml 4.14.3) over
# ssh, from a tee on both directions of an -sshcmd shim, as the oracle's
# remote mode runs (tools/oracle/README.md, "Remote roots"). The first sync
# copies three new files from the client's root to the server's (plain
# contents); the second inserts 800 bytes into a 300 000-byte file on the
# client's root and appends 4000 bytes to another on the server's, so rsync
# goes both ways. Columns: the sync, the direction, the section (argument,
# result or stream chunk), the command, and the section's body (tag and
# value) in hex. Stream chunks over 16 KiB are left out.
